timeline_reviews.summary: Serial transport stream accounting source; no semantic events projected and no delegation events are present.
Serial parent trajectory: independently probed, implemented, fixed, fuzzed, and packaged the Node port without child agents.

parallel.requirements: Recognized a byte-exact Python-to-Node migration requiring ESM .mjs modules, manual argv parity for --a/--b/--c, no npm dependencies, and /output/test4.mjs delivery.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent retained implementation and artifact ownership, while a probe workflow characterized black-box behavior and a late verifier workflow attempted broad independent checking.
parallel.implementation: Built a modular JS runtime emulating argparse, schedule, Python regex, Unicode digits, int parsing, linecache, traceback, terminal width, and stdout/stderr behavior, then patched probe-discovered bugs.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Parent wrote the deliverable and modules under /output; artifact validation later found the expected entry point and module tree.
parallel.verification: Used probe workflow findings, local differential checks across /workspace/dataset, /output, and /tmp, and a late comprehensive workflow that never returned before timeout.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No official correctness gap remained, but the verifier workflow and its active child agents were killed before an aggregate result reached the parent.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, no external dependency, manual argv, behavior parity, and /output/test4.mjs delivery requirements from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked as a single owner: probed the executable, wrote modules, debugged mismatches, expanded tests, and packaged the artifact without delegation.
serial.implementation: Implemented argparse formatting/parsing, Unicode digit behavior, schedule.at validation, traceback rendering, and process-output behavior in local modules.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Created /output/test4.mjs and support libraries, then moved test harnesses into /output/tests while keeping the artifact tree coherent.
serial.verification: Ran hand differential tests, cwd-specific traceback checks, 920 value fuzz cases, 700 argv vectors, syntax checks, and final byte-level checks before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial process also timed out without a final message, but its current status official retry passed and no delegated verifier work was left unresolved.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the Node ESM, no-external-dependency, manual argv, output-parity, and /output/test4.mjs requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run received and acted on the identical prompt requirements for the same Python source and executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-coverage difference; both solved the same hard parity task and passed official evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent kept implementation ownership while delegating black-box probing and late verification to workflows.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent used a single-owner workflow: it probed, implemented, debugged, and tested the port itself.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used child specialization for probes and verifier review; serial concentrated all ownership in the parent process.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child prompts defined probe and verifier scopes, with the verifier asked to compare stdout and exit codes and not edit /output.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained all context locally and corrected subtle harness, linecache, and digit-value issues as it discovered them.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel context moved through workflow briefs and results; serial had no handoff boundary and used local observations directly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a larger modular port under lib/py, lib/argparse, lib/schedule, and /output/test4.mjs, then patched bugs from probes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial built a similar modular port under lib/python, lib/argparse, and lib/schedule, then rewrote targeted pieces after differential failures.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both converged on faithful ports through iterative fixes; the parallel path incorporated child probe findings, while serial derived fixes locally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Probe child results were available and partly used, but the late verifier workflow was killed with no aggregate result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial local test results returned directly in sequence, including the all-three-suite pass at 93/93, 920 fuzz cases, and 700 argv vectors.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The main lifecycle difference is the parallel run's unfinished child-verifier result; serial had no child result to join.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent was the implementation writer and the artifact validator captured a coherent final tree with /output/test4.mjs and support modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial likewise produced one coherent artifact tree with /output/test4.mjs, libraries, and test helpers moved under tests/.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-write collision explains the outcome; both final trees validated, with the parallel tree produced under parent ownership despite child activity.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel passed 57/57 local cwd checks and official evaluation, but the late comprehensive verifier workflow did not complete.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran repaired differential tests and fuzz suites to zero mismatches, then the official retry completed and passed 70/70.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had strong acceptance evidence; serial's final local verification returned, while parallel's broad child verifier did not.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used twelve child logs and timed out at the agent budget with an active killed verifier workflow.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out at the process level, but with workflows disabled and no delegation; it had already run its local suites and artifact validation passed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The distinctive parallel closure issue is unfinished child verification at timeout, not a failed artifact.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status.json evaluations show both runs passed all 70 official samples. The serial evaluation summary file is stale from an initial evaluator startup failure, but status.json records a completed retry. Therefore there is no discordant official outcome to explain; the concrete difference is that parallel used child workflows and lost a late verifier result, while serial used sequential local debugging and verification.
parallel_contributors: Probe workflow outputs supplied detailed argparse, help-width, schedule.at, Unicode, and environment findings that the parent incorporated.
The parent retained implementation control and achieved passing official behavior before the process timed out.
The late verifier workflow did not return an aggregate result before closure.
serial_contributors: Serial rebuilt the same behavior through direct probing and self-managed differential tests.
Serial fixed local harness, traceback, digit-value, and parser bugs before running broad local fuzz checks.
Serial had no child lifecycle boundary; workflows were disabled and official retry passed.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel fixed specific bugs such as --a=-- handling and COLUMNS/help wrapping after probe-guided checks.
Serial initially had failing differential cases and fixed digit-value, linecache, and argparse single-dash handling locally.
evaluator_effects: serial/cell/evaluation/summary.json is stale and incomplete; serial/cell/status.json records the authoritative completed retry with 70/70.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; only process-level contrast and one retained adverse parallel lifecycle episode

candidates.reason: The parent launched a comprehensive verifier workflow, but the workflow state shows status killed, result null, and active verifier children when the run ended.
candidates.realized_consequence: The verifier workflow's in-progress verification work was interrupted and unavailable to the parent before closure.
candidates.near_match_reason: Fan-out and budget pressure were present, but the retained boundary is the direct interruption of active verifier children before their result finalized.

Rejected: implementation edits and fixes preceded the local verification passes rather than being merged after final checks.
Rejected: no completed delegated implementation was left unretrieved; delegated work was probing and verification, not a child-owned implementation.
Rejected as same-chain downstream: the verifier workflow had no completed aggregate finding returned to the parent because its active children were killed.
Rejected as same-chain downstream: the run ended at the kill point, leaving no separate parent decision window after the child failure.
Rejected: completed probe findings were inspected and acted on; no completed child result was visibly ignored.
Rejected: while the late workflow ran, the parent continued code tightening and local rechecks instead of passively waiting without inspection.
Rejected: there were no competing child-owned implementations across different files that claimed overlapping behavior.
Rejected: no two live agents edited the same source/configuration file and forced reconciliation.
Rejected: no non-entry source created or owned by another live agent was replaced by the parent or a sibling.
Rejected: no live agent replaced the required entry file while another agent owned or used it.
Rejected: no broad final-tree cleanup invalidated another agent's final workspace work or provenance.
Rejected: multiple agents observed and tested the workspace, but no concrete unstable state or provenance problem from shared writes occurred.
Rejected: no child-generated fixture, cache, temp path, or auxiliary implementation was consumed as a stable reference by another actor.

retained_patterns.reason: A late comprehensive verifier workflow was launched after substantial local checks, but workflow state records it as killed with result null and child verifier agents still in progress.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The parent never received the comprehensive verifier verdict before closure, leaving that child verification work unusable despite the final official pass.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: Fan-out and timeout pressure are visible, but the most specific gate-clearing event is the interruption of active verifier children before their result finalized.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Fan-out Budget Exhaustion, Missing Verifier Return, No Failure Takeover, and Blind Timeout Wait were considered for the same late-verifier timeout chain but not retained as separate labels.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; only the killed verifier workflow cleared the paired retention gate.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: No numeric cap was applied; same-chain timeout symptoms were suppressed to avoid multiplying labels around one verifier interruption episode.
